description.en: Heals surrounding allies 3 times, each restoring HP equal to 100% of Cancer's ATK + 70 and removing 1 debuff.
description.zh: 治疗周围友方3次，每次恢复相当于巨蟹座攻击力100%+70的生命值，并移除1个减益效果。

description.de: Heilt den schwächsten Verbündeten und stellt LP in Höhe von 250% ANG wieder her.
description.en: Restores HP equal to 250% ATK to the weakest ally.
description.es: Restaura PS equivalentes al 250 % del ATQ al aliado más vulnerable.
description.zh: 为最弱的友方恢复相当于攻击力250%的生命值。

description.en: When an ally drops below 30% HP, they gain Super Armor for 6s and a shield equal to 300% of ATK. It can trigger only once per battle.
description.zh: 当友方生命值低于30%时，其获得霸体与相当于攻击力300%的护盾，持续6秒。每场战斗只能触发一次。

description.de: Erhöht die SCH-RED des nächsten Verbündeten in der Vorderreihe während des Kampfes um 15 %.
description.en: Increases DMG RED of the nearest frontline ally by 15% during battle.
description.es: Aumenta la Reduc. de daño del aliado de la vanguardia más cercano en un 15 % durante la batalla.
description.zh: 战斗中使最近的前排友方减伤提升15%。

level2.es: aumenta la Reduc. de daño al 20 %.

level3.de: Erhöht die M-RES dieser Einheit zusätzlich um 50 %.
level3.en: Increases that unit's M-RES by an additional 50%.
level3.es: Aumenta la RES M de esa unidad en un 50 % adicional.
